title: Gajah Mada
summary: Gajah Mada was the chief minister of fourteenth-century Majapahit in Java. The Pararaton, as summarised by Aoyama, has him put down a rebellion about 1319 and later swear not to enjoy palapa until the outer islands came under Majapahit. Expeditions to Bali and Sumbawa followed, and he died in 1364.

uncertainty.note: Birth year is not given in the opened sources. Start is the earliest dated activity (a rebellion he suppressed "in about 1319"); end is his death in 1364. The span is his documented career, not his lifespan.
